answer: The agent ocean is open water, so a marketplace must guard its narrow inlet with a delivery-escrowed identity. First, the agent locks 20 POA in escrow and gets a non-transferable onyx-stamped passport. Second, it completes five deliveries, each signed off by a different buyer. Third, each verified delivery releases 20% of the escrow and adds a reputation notch, while fraud slashes the deposit and burns the passport. Forging 10,000 fake traders then costs 200,000 POA plus 50,000 jobs. Like a harbor admitting ships only through one guarded inlet, the market stays open yet hard to flood.
